contract_completeness: Every required field has an explicit JSON type, shape, defining equation or predicate, and canonicalization rule.

cycle.definition: loop-entry path whose last state returns by one edge to first

loop_entry.definition: shared prefix end and cycle start

prefix.canonicalization: starts at input initial, follows edges

representation_conventions: Indices are zero-based unless a mathematical exponent or degree is explicitly named. Matrices are row-major; nested tensor array order is stated per task.

A rational scalar is a reduced JSON string "n" or "n/d" with positive denominator. JSON integers are used only where the field contract says integer. Floats, decimal approximations, NaN and infinity are invalid.
The submission object has exactly required_fields, with no additional keys. Nested objects likewise use exactly the named keys.
task_rules: State identifiers are input integers. prefix starts at initial; prefix[-1]=loop_entry=cycle[0]. Consecutive prefix/cycle states follow input edges, and cycle[-1] has an edge back to cycle[0].

The finite displayed path is prefix followed by cycle[1:] (do not duplicate the loop entry). It contains no state labelled bad, contains a request with no later grant, and the cycle contains no grant.
monitor_trace aligns with the displayed path. At each state process grant first (clear pending), then req (set pending); emit exactly clear or pending.
